topic: Choose a weekend hiking destination for two friends

scenario.topic: Choose a weekend hiking destination for two friends
scenario.opening_question: What matters more for our weekend hike: scenery, challenge, or convenience?

options.name: Eagle Rock Loop Trail
options.upside: Offers panoramic cliff views and a waterfall
options.tradeoff: Some steep sections may be tiring
options.concern: Trail can be crowded on weekends
options.best_for: scenery lovers who want a moderate challenge

options.name: Pine Ridge Forest Path
options.upside: Easy terrain with dense forest and birdwatching
options.tradeoff: Less varied scenery, mostly shaded woods
options.concern: May feel too easy or short for some
options.best_for: those prioritizing relaxation and low effort

options.name: Summit Ridge Peak Trail
options.upside: Challenging hike with rewarding summit views
options.tradeoff: Longer and more strenuous, requires good fitness
options.concern: May be too exhausting for a casual day
options.best_for: those seeking a physical challenge and views

options.name: Lakeside Meadow Walk
options.upside: Scenic lakeside route with picnic spots
options.tradeoff: Shorter hike with fewer elevation changes
options.concern: Limited trail variety and fewer wildlife sightings
options.best_for: those wanting a peaceful, easy outdoor experience

shared_context: We are two friends planning a day hike this Saturday.
We want to keep total travel and hiking time under 8 hours.
Our combined budget for gas and park fees is under $40.

personas.name: Hana
personas.background: Hana prefers moderate hikes with scenic views but is sensitive to stress and crowds.
personas.private_goal: She wants a manageable trail that offers beautiful sights without overwhelming difficulty or too many people.
personas.rejection_reason: Summit Ridge is too strenuous and exhausting for a casual day, which conflicts with Hana's preference for manageable hikes.
